queue.title: VIDEO-E2E — Full pipeline test with real APIs (Whisper→LLM→TTS→QC)
queue.rationale: Run complete SCS-001 pipeline end-to-end with ALL available API keys. Input: 1 trending topic. Output: 1 finished video with real voiceover, LLM-rewritten script, real captions. Log every step timing + cost. Identify which API integrations work vs. which need fallbacks. This is the REALITY CHECK sprint.

queue.title: FALLBACK — Local TTS via Piper + free caption overlay via FFmpeg drawtext
queue.rationale: For April 7 gate we need to produce videos NOW, not wait for paid API keys. Build zero-cost fallback: (1) Piper TTS (local, free, good quality) replaces ElevenLabs, (2) Enhanced FFmpeg drawtext replaces JSON2Video for captions, (3) Skip Captions.ai avatar — use text-on-video with better templates. Gate: produce 5 videos using ONLY free/local tools.

queue.title: POSTING — Manual posting workflow via Telegram /post command
queue.rationale: April 7 gate = 30 TikTok posts. TikTok API rejected. Blotato costs $29/mo. Fastest path: (1) Pipeline produces video + caption, (2) /post command sends video + caption to Telegram, (3) Human manually posts to TikTok from phone (copy caption, upload video). Add /post command that: picks best unposted video from queue, sends it with ready-to-paste caption + hashtags. Track posted count in workspace/posting-log.json.

queue.title: POSTING — Batch video preparation for manual TikTok posting
queue.rationale: Produce 5 videos in one pipeline run, send ALL to Telegram in sequence. Each message: video file + caption text + hashtags + posting instructions. Human can then post 5 at once to TikTok. Add /batch command. Target: prepare 5 posts per session, 2 sessions per day = 10 posts/day. At that rate, 30 posts in 3 days.

queue.title: QUALITY — Video template system with 3 proven formats
queue.rationale: Current videos use one format. Create 3 template types: (1) Split-screen (original clip left, commentary right), (2) Reaction-style (clip plays then cut to text commentary), (3) Greenscreen (text overlay on clip). Each template: FFmpeg filter_complex preset + caption placement + music bed. Randomly assign template per video for variety.

queue.title: QUALITY — Background music library + auto-mixing
queue.rationale: Videos need background music for engagement. Create workspace/music/ with 10 royalty-free tracks (different vibes: energetic, dramatic, chill, motivational). FFmpeg auto-mixes: music at -20dB under voiceover, +5dB during clip segments. Random track selection per video. Source: pixabay.com/music (free commercial use).

queue.title: QUALITY — Hook optimization engine using viral transcript analysis
queue.rationale: Sprint 248 built Whisper transcription. Use transcripts of viral clips to extract hook patterns. Build hook template library from top-performing clips: 'Did you know...', 'This changed everything...', 'Nobody is talking about...'. LLM selects best hook template per topic. Measure: first-3-second retention proxy via hook formula scoring.

queue.title: GATE-TRACKER — April 7 countdown dashboard + daily posting quota

Need: (1) Telegram /gate command showing: posts done/30, views/500, days remaining, required posts/day, (2) Daily reminder at 9am: 'You need X posts today', (3) Gate dashboard panel on localhost:4000. Wire into daily digest. If pace falls behind, escalate to URGENT.
